rationale: Earlier RQ-SNN-004 runs used the productive reward-STDP path on a dirty source tree and lacked an explicit direction-matched control. This prospective clean-tree experiment isolates the registered pair-based STDP rule and tests signed Pre/Post timing asymmetry directly without making a functional-learning claim.

timing_semantics.zero_delta_t: simultaneous timing control; expected no weight change

analysis_plan.inference_policy: Deterministic component experiment. Repeated evaluations verify identity only and are not treated as statistically independent samples; no p-values or sampling confidence intervals are used.
primary_decision_gates: All 11 timing conditions are present with 10 repeated evaluations each.
Every positive delta_t condition has mean_delta_weight > 0.
Every negative delta_t condition has mean_delta_weight < 0.
Within every mirrored |delta_t| pair, absolute depression magnitude is greater than potentiation magnitude, reflecting the frozen a_minus > a_plus parameterization.
All repeated evaluations within a timing condition are numerically identical.
Mean LTP is positive, mean LTD is negative, and absolute mean LTD exceeds mean LTP.
analysis_plan.support_status: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_PREREGISTERED_PROTOCOL only if all integrity and primary scientific gates pass.
analysis_plan.failure_status: NO_PREDEFINED_SUPPORT_DETECTED if execution is valid but one or more scientific gates fail.
analysis_plan.integrity_failure_status: NOT_TESTED_INTEGRITY_FAILURE if source freeze, protocol constants, artifact coverage or runtime integrity fails.

integrity_constraints: clean source tree immediately before execution
no modification of src/, configs/, tests/, research/schemas/ or pyproject.toml in the experiment branch
exact registered timing grid and STDP parameterization
claim_boundary: This experiment can support only the scoped implementation-level claim that the registered pair-based STDP rule produces signed and asymmetric weight changes across the fixed Pre/Post timing curve. It does not establish useful learning, task-performance improvement, network-level memory, biological equivalence, scaling, a 5D advantage, human-reviewed EVID or independent replication.

gate_protection.source_digest_policy: Do not modify src/, configs/, tests/, research/schemas/ or pyproject.toml.
gate_protection.merge_policy: Merge only after the experiment verifier and full pull-request CI are green.
